test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which benefit of MFls is mentioned besides lending money?
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Microfinance Institutions (MFIs) do more than just provide loans; they also empower borrowers by enhancing their financial knowledge. (वित्तीय साक्षरता प्रशिक्षण)
 
• They regularly offer training to borrowers on managing cash flows, understanding interest charges, and handling repayment schedules effectively.
 
• Such financial literacy ensures that borrowers make informed decisions and reduce the risk of over-indebtedness.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** Granting land titles (भूमि शीर्षक प्रदान करना) – Not mentioned in the passage as a benefit of MFIs.
 
• **Option 3:** Tax exemptions (कर में छूट) – Not discussed in the context of MFIs in the passage.
 
• **Option 4:** Import-export facilitation (आयात-निर्यात सुविधा) – No reference made to MFIs providing this service.

fb:Ta3b,
The correct answer is **Option 3**.
